title: The quadratic control and the callers could pass under the 20 ms floor on a host fast enough, because the run length was fixed
resolution: The helper doubles both runs until the short median reaches 20 ms, up to 2^24 characters, and takes an injected timer; scripted readings test the doubling, floor, and limit, with a fail-before, and the spec scenarios follow.

title: Importing the package set the expose-gc flag and made a VM context in every importer, unlike the design's claim
resolution: gc is exposed on the first timing with the default timer; a test that only imports the package checks that gc stays undefined, with a fail-before, and design.md states the scope.

title: The record gave a growth of 1.25 where the floored metric of the assertion was 0.25
resolution: The record separates raw ratios from floored scores, gives the measured maximum score of the new helper, and calls the results consistent with linear scaling over the tested inputs.
